title: Ex 1.1 #11 · {x ∈ ℤ : |x| < 5}
prompt: Write the set $\{x \in \mathbb{Z} : |x| < 5\}$ by listing its elements between braces.
answer_format: A set listed between braces, like {1, 2, 3} (∅ for the empty set). Steps are optional.
hints: Rewrite |x| < 5 without the absolute value: it's a pair of inequalities.
Keep the integers strictly between −5 and 5.
solution: |x| < 5 means −5 < x < 5, so the elements are the integers −4 through 4.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words.
